y-m-79-04.title: Bathi intengiso yevenkile yesisombululo seqhwa ikhule nge-30% kwinyanga
y-m-79-04.topic: Ukwahluka kwamaxesha onyaka kwidatha yothotho lwamaxesha nokuthelekisa unyaka ngonyaka
y-m-79-04.goal: Yazi kutheni izinga lokukhula kwinyanga enye lodwa lenza kube nzima ukugweba ukukhula, uze ucoce ugwebo lwakho usebenzisa uthelekiso nenyanga efanayo yonyaka odlulileyo nolunye ulwazi (inani lezihlalo).
y-m-79-04.material: Intengiso yevenkile yesisombululo seqhwa kule Juni yayiyi-120만 원, yaye intengiso kaJulayi yayiyi-156만 원. Umnini wathi, "Intengiso ikhule kangangama-30% kwinyanga enye, ngoko ivenkile yethu ikhula ngokukhawuleza ngokucacileyo!" (Iyunithi: 만 원. Thatha ukuba iinyanga zombini zinamalanga okusebenza afanayo.)
y-m-79-04.thinking.1: Ukukhetha isiseko sokuthelekisa (inyanga edlulileyo okanye inyanga efanayo yonyaka odlulileyo) wena nokubala
y-m-79-04.prereq.0: Lo msebenzi ubekwe kubunzima be-H3 (inqanaba elinzima), uthatha abafundi abafunda isifundo sokukhetha sesikolo samabanga aphezulu 'Practical Statistics', yaye akathethi ukuba iSebe lezeMfundo lisabela eli candelo kwibanga elithile. Izinto ezifunekayo kwangaphambili: ukubala amazinga okukhula (amaphesenti) nokufunda iitafile. Kulo msebenzi, igama elithi ukwahluka kwamaxesha onyaka lichazwa ngokumalunga 'njengempembelelo yexesha onyaka ephindaphindayo ngonyaka ngamnye'.
y-m-79-04.s.s1.prompt: Ingaba amanani angentla (kule Juni 120만 원, Julayi 156만 원) anele ukuthi 'ivenkile ikhule'?
y-m-79-04.s.s1.hint.0: Cinga ukuba intengiso yevenkile yesisombululo seqhwa inyuka yehle nini ngonyaka, uze ucinge ukuba utshintsho ukusuka kuJuni ukuya kuJulayi lunokwenzeka rhoqo ngonyaka.
y-m-79-04.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala phantsi ukuba ngawaphi amanani amabini ekufuneka uwathelekise ukuqinisekisa 'ikhule' ngempembelelo yexesha onyaka isusiwe.
y-m-79-04.s.s1.o.a: Kwanele. Ukuba intengiso ikhule kangangama-30% kwinyanga, kukukhula okukhulu ngokucacileyo.
y-m-79-04.s.s1.r.a: Ufunde ukunyuka okukhulu kwinyanga enye njengokukhula. Kwivenkile echatshazelwa ngamaxesha onyaka njengesisombululo seqhwa, ukunyuka kusenokuba lolo luphindaphindayo ngonyaka ngamnye.
y-m-79-04.s.s1.o.b: Ayonelanga. Sidinga intengiso kaAgasti nayo ngaphambi kokuba sikwazi ukugweba.
y-m-79-04.s.s1.r.b: Ngaphandle kokulinda ukuya kuAgasti, unokutshintsha isiseko sokuthelekisa ngaphakathi kwedatha osele unayo.
y-m-79-04.s.s1.o.c: Ayonelanga. Sidinga nentengiso yenyanga efanayo yonyaka odlulileyo.
y-m-79-04.s.s1.r.c: Le yingcamango yokucoca impembelelo yexesha onyaka ngokuthelekisa iinyanga ezifanayo.
y-m-79-04.s.s1.o.d: Ayonelanga. Sidinga nokusasazwa kwentengiso yezinye iivenkile kulo nyaka.
y-m-79-04.s.s1.r.d: Ukuthelekisa neevenkile ezikufuphi nayo yingcamango ewulungileyo, kodwa ayinceda ngokuthe ngqo ekwahluleni ukuba ukunyuka kwale venkile kungenxa yexesha onyaka.
y-m-79-04.s.s1.explain: Ukunyuka ukusuka kuJuni ukuya kuJulayi kusenokuba kungenxa yexesha eliphezulu lehlobo. Ukwahlula ukukhula kwimpembelelo yexesha onyaka, udinga idatha 'yexesha elifanayo', njengoJuni noJulayi wonyaka odlulileyo.
y-m-79-04.s.s1.acc.0: Ukuthelekisa neminye imivenkile nalo lulwazi olwenzakalisayo. Nangona kunjalo, ukwahlula impembelelo yexesha onyaka yale venkile ngokwayo, idatha yenyanga efanayo yonyaka odlulileyo ithe ngqo ngakumbi.
y-m-79-04.s.s2.prompt: Idatha yonyaka odlulileyo ifikile. Intengiso kaJuni wonyaka odlulileyo yayiyi-100만 원 kaJulayi yayiyi-140만 원. Bhala indlela oza kuthelekisa ngayo uze ubale ukuba 'ivenkile ikhule' ngale datha, uze ubhale oko ungathi kumnini njengesiphumo.

y-m-79-04.s.s2.model.0: Thelekisa nenyanga efanayo yonyaka odlulileyo. UJuni ukhule ukusuka kwi-100만 원 ukuya kwi-120만 원, wanda nge-20%, uJulayi ukhule ukusuka kwi-140만 원 ukuya kwi-156만 원, wanda malunga nama-11%. Lo nyaka nawo ungaphezulu kunonyaka odlulileyo, kodwa izinga lokukhula lehlile, yaye ukunyuka kwama-30% ukusuka kuJuni ukuya kuJulayi kwakungama-40% nonyaka odlulileyo, ngoko impembelelo yehlobo inkulu.
y-m-79-04.s.s2.model.1: Uthelekiso nenyanga edlulileyo luxuba impembelelo yexesha onyaka, ngoko ndithelekise izinga lokukhula likaJuni ukuya kuJulayi wonyaka odlulileyo (40%) nezinga lokukhula lwalo nyaka (30%). Izinga lokukhula lwalo nyaka laliphantsi. Intengiso ingaphezulu kweenyanga ezifanayo zonyaka odlulileyo, ngoko ndingaxelela umnini ukuba ivenkile ikhule, kodwa isantya sicotha.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.prompt: Ulwazi olutsha olufundiweyo: le venkile yandise inani layo lezihlalo nge-20% ngaphezu konyaka odlulileyo ekupheleni kukaMeyi kulo nyaka. Ukubonisa nolu lwazi, sesiphi eso siyona tolikho ifanelekileyo yotshintsho 'lwentengiso ngesihlalo' xa kuthelekiswa nonyaka odlulileyo? (Intengiso ngesihlalo = intengiso ÷ inani lezihlalo)
y-m-79-04.s.s3.hint.0: Yahlula intengiso kaJuni noJulayi walo nyaka nganye nge-1.2, uze uzijike zibe ngamaxabiso enani lezihlalo elifanayo nonyaka odlulileyo.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.hint.1: Beka amaxabiso aguqulweyo ecaleni kwentengiso yeenyanga ezifanayo zonyaka odlulileyo uze uthelekise ukuba ayalingana, makhulu, okanye mancinci.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.o.a: KuJuni, intengiso ngesihlalo ifana nonyaka odlulileyo, yaye kuJulayi yehle malunga nama-7%.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.r.a: Ujonge izinga lokukhula lwezihlalo kunye nezinga lokukhula lentengiso. UJuni yi-120 ÷ 1.2 = 100, efanayo nonyaka odlulileyo, kaJulayi yi-156 ÷ 1.2 = 130, encinci kune-140 yonyaka odlulileyo.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.o.b: Intengiso ngesihlalo yanda ngaphezu konyaka odlulileyo kuzo zombini uJuni noJulayi.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.r.b: Intengiso kaJuni ikhule nge-20% yaye izihlalo nazo zikhule nge-20%. Ukuba ulinganisa amazinga amabini okukhula, kunzima ukuthi intengiso ngesihlalo ikhule.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.o.c: Inani lezihlalo alinampembelelo kwintengiso, ngoko utoliko lwangaphambili luhleli njengoko lunjalo.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.r.c: Ukuba izihlalo ziyanda, abathengi onokubaphatha ngexesha elifanayo nabo bayanda. Kunzima ukubanga ukuba inani lezihlalo alinxulumananga nentengiso.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.o.d: KuJulayi, intengiso ngesihlalo ikhule malunga nama-11%, ngoko ikhule ngaphezu kukaJuni.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.r.d: Ufunde izinga lokukhula lentengiso eliyi-11% njengezinga lokukhula lentengiso ngesihlalo. Yahlula ngenyaniso yokuba izihlalo zikhule nge-20%.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.explain: Izihlalo zaba ngama-1.2 amaxesha, ngoko ukuba wahlula intengiso yalo nyaka nge-1.2 ukulinganisa inani lezihlalo nesiseko sonyaka odlulileyo, uJuni yi-120 ÷ 1.2 = 100 (efanayo ne-100 yonyaka odlulileyo), yaye uJulayi yi-156 ÷ 1.2 = 130 (malunga nama-7.1% ngaphantsi kwe-140 yonyaka odlulileyo). Nangona intengiso ikhule, intengiso ngesihlalo yahlala injalo okanye yehla. Ukuba ukwandiswa kwezihlalo kwakusisizathu sokunyuka kwentengiso, intsingiselo ye 'khula' iyatshintsha.

y-m-79-03.title: Imveliso 'eyi-95% echanekileyo' umatshini wokuhlola obiza ngokuba iphosakele
y-m-79-03.goal: Qinisekisa ngamanani ukuba xa umphumo wovavanyo uthi 'uphosakele', isabelo esiphosakele ngokwenene sixhomekeke kakhulu kuzinga lokuphosakala (izinga lesiseko) nezinga lokugweba ngokungalunganga, uze ufumane wena iimeko ezininzi ezanelisa iimeko.
y-m-79-03.material:
Oku kulandelayo kuyaziwa malunga nomatshini wokuhlola ozenzekelayo wefektri.
- Izinto ezingalunganga zi-1% yazo zonke iimveliso.
- Isabelo sezinto ezingalunganga ezigwetywa njengezingalunganga si-95%.
- Isabelo sezinto eziqhelekileyo ezigwetywe ngokungalunganga njengezingalunganga si-5%.

Intengiso yomatshini ithi 'Ukuchaneka 95%'. Umfundi omnye wathi, "Ithuba lokuba imveliso eyibizwe ngokuba iphosakele ngumatshini iphosakele ngokwenene li-95%," waza wasebenza ngolu hlobo usebenzisa iimveliso ezili-10000.
y-m-79-03.thinking.2: Ukuthetha ukuba luluphi ulwazi olulahlekileyo kwibinzana lentengiso
y-m-79-03.prereq.0: Lo msebenzi ubekwe kubunzima obuyi-H3 (inqanaba elinzima), ucinga abafundi abathatha isifundo esikhethwayo sesikolo samabanga aphezulu 'Practical Statistics', kwaye awuthethi ukuba iSebe lezeMfundo lisabela esi siqulatho kwibanga elithile. Izinto ezifunekayo: ukubala iipesenti nemilinganiselo, nendlela yokumisela iyonke ibe yi-10000 nokubala 'bangaphi'. (Akufuneki usebenzise iifomyula zethuba.) Ukuba sele ufunde ithuba elinemeko, unokuhlola ixabiso elifanayo ngefomyula.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala ekusebenzeni komfundi ophosakeleyo.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.hint.0: Phindaphinda amanani kumgca ngamnye wena uhlole ukuba alungile.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.hint.1: Kumlinganiselo womgca wokugqibela, thelekisa 'umlinganiselo wantoni kwantoni', nokuba inani oyahlula ngalo liqela elifanayo 'neemveliso ezibizwe ngokuba ziphosakele' zombuzo.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.line.0: Ukuba kuhlolwa iimveliso ezingama-10000, kukho izinto ezili-100 eziyonakeleyo nezinto ezingama-9900 eziqhelekileyo.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.line.1: Kwizinto ezili-100 eziyonakeleyo, ama-95% (izinto ezingama-95) agwetywa njengonakeleyo.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.line.2: Kwizinto ezingama-9900 eziqhelekileyo, nama-5% (izinto ezingama-495) agwetywa njengonakeleyo.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.line.4: Kuzo, ezonakeleyo ngokwenene zingama-95, ngoko isabelo segwebo lokonakala elilolonakala ngokwenene yi-95 ÷ 100 = 95%.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.explain: Imigca yoku-1 ukuya kwesi-4 ilunge. Kumgca wesi-5 ama-95 alunge, kodwa inani olahlula ngalo kufuneka libe ngama-590, 'zonke iimveliso ezigwetywe njengeyonakeleyo'. Ama-100 linani lezinto ezonakeleyo ngokwenene, ngoko alihambelani nombuzo. 95 ÷ 590 ≈ 0.161, oko kukuthi, malunga nama-16.1%.
y-m-79-03.s.s2.prompt: Cinga ngomatshini wohlolo onezinga lokonakala le-p%, apho isabelo sezinto eziqhelekileyo ezigwetywe ngokungalunganga njengeyonakeleyo si-q%. (Isabelo sezinto ezonakeleyo ezigwetywe njengeyonakeleyo sihlala sikuma-95%.) Thatha ukuba zininzi iimveliso, uze wenze (p, q) ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo apho ubuncinane isiqingatha (50%) seemveliso ezigwetywe njengeyonakeleyo zonakele ngokwenene. p no-q ngamanani aphelele ukusuka ku-1 ukuya kwi-10.

y-m-79-01.title: Oko Isishwankathelo Samanani Amahlanu Sinokukuxelela Kona
y-m-79-01.goal: Ukusuka kwisishwankathelo samanani amahlanu (elona lincinci, iikwatayili, i-median, elona likhulu), hlukanisa oko kunokuthethwa nokungenakuthethwa ngokuqinisekileyo, wenze wena iiseti zedatha ezahlukeneyo ezabelana ngesishwankathelo esifanayo ukubonisa imida yesishwankathelo.
y-m-79-01.material:
Utitshala unike iziphumo zovavanyo lokusebenza (0 ukuya kwi-50 amanqaku, onke amanqaku ngamanani apheleleyo) olwathathwa ngabafundi aba-7 kwiklasi enye kuphela njengo-'sishwankathelo samanani amahlanu'.

Elona lincinci amanqaku ayi-10, ikwatayili yokuqala amanqaku ayi-15, i-median amanqaku ayi-20, ikwatayili yesithathu amanqaku angama-30, elona likhulu amanqaku angama-50.

Ivenkoni: ukuba amanqaku abafundi aba-7 abekwe ukusuka kwelona lincinci ukuya kwelona likhulu ngu-x1, x2, ..., x7 (x-nye ukuya ku-x-sixhenxe), elona lincinci ngu-x1, ikwatayili yokuqala ngu-x2, i-median ngu-x4, ikwatayili yesithathu ngu-x6, kwaye elona likhulu ngu-x7. Abafundi abaliqela basenokuba namanqaku afanayo.
y-m-79-01.thinking.1: Ukwenza iiseti zedatha ezahlukeneyo ezinesishwankathelo esifanayo (imizekelo echasayo)

Izinto ezifunekayo: indlela yokuhlela idatha ukusuka kwelona lincinci ukuya kwelona likhulu nokufumana i-median neekwatayili, nentsingiselo yomndilili. Kulo msebenzi, kuyavunyelwa ukuba iikwatayili zamaxabiso edatha ayi-7 ziyi-'2nd, 4th, no-6th amaxabiso ukusuka kwelona lincinci' (indlela yokumisela iikwatayili isenokwahluka kancinci kwincwadi nencwadi).

y-m-79-06.title: Ukumisela ixabiso lokufunwa komnyhadala
y-m-79-06.goal: Sebenzisa ixabiso elilindelekileyo, yila uyilo oluninzi lwentlawulo yokungena neemivuzo, uze ucacise umahluko phakathi kwesiphumo esinye nomndilili wexesha elide.
y-m-79-06.material:
Kumnyhadala wesikolo, iklasi yethu iqhuba ukufunwa kwemivuzo. Kukho iiphepha zokufunwa ezili-100 ebhokisini, yaye umthathi nxaxheba ubhatala intlawulo yokungena yi-f won atsale iphepha elinye (ukubala okungezantsi kusebenzisa umndilili ngephepha).
- iphepha e-1 lomvuzo wokuqala: ikhadi leesipho le-P won
- amaphepha ayi-9 omvuzo wesibini: ikhadi leesipho le-2000 won
- amaphepha asele ama-90: angenanto (akukho mvuzo)

Iklasi yethu ibhatala amakhadi eesipho ngexabiso elibhaliweyo. Thatha ukuba akukho ndleko ezinye. Umfundi omnye wathi, "Ndabhatala i-1000 won, ndafumana umvuzo wokuqala, ndafumana ikhadi leesipho, ngoko oku kufunwa kuyahambelana nabathathi nxaxheba."
y-m-79-06.prereq.0: Lo msebenzi ubekwe kubunzima be-H3 (inqanaba elinzima), uthatha abafundi abafunda isifundo sokukhetha sesikolo samabanga aphezulu 'Practical Statistics', yaye akathethi ukuba iSebe lezeMfundo lisabela eli candelo kwibanga elithile. Izinto ezifunekayo kwangaphambili: intsingiselo nokubala kwexabiso elilindelekileyo (isixa somvuzo × ithuba). Kulo msebenzi, ixabiso elilindelekileyo lifundwa 'njengomndilili wentlawulo ngephepha'. Umthetho wamanani amakhulu usetyenziswa kuphela kwinqanaba lengcamango.
y-m-79-06.s.s1.prompt: Yeyiphi eyona ndlela ifanelekileyo yokuvavanya ibango lomfundi elingentla?
y-m-79-06.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ufumane ukuba isixa sonke samanani amakhadi eesipho kuwo onke amaphepha ayi-100 siya kuba yintoni.
y-m-79-06.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa 'umndilili ngephepha', eso sixa sonke sahlulwe ngo-100, nentlawulo yokungena.
y-m-79-06.s.s1.o.a: Ayinakwaziwa ngesiphumo esinye. Kufuneka sijonge ukuba kufunyanwa kangakanani ngomndilili kuwo onke amaphepha.
y-m-79-06.s.s1.r.a: Le yingcamango yokugweba ngomndilili wamazama amaninzi kunesiphumo esinye.
y-m-79-06.s.s1.o.b: Kukho iphepha lomvuzo wokuqala e-1 kuphela, ngoko ithuba li-1%, yaye oku kufunwa kungenakuhambelana nabathathi nxaxheba ngokuqinisekileyo.
y-m-79-06.s.s1.r.b: Ujonge kuphela ithuba lomvuzo wokuqala. Kufuneka ufumane umndilili kubandakanywa imivuzo yamaphepha ayi-9 omvuzo wesibini.
y-m-79-06.s.s1.o.c: Isiphumo sokuzama kanye sisona sibungqina siqinisekileyo, ngoko ibango lilunge.
y-m-79-06.s.s1.r.c: Isiphumo esinye somntu omnye sinokuba yimpambano. Kuphela ngokudlala umdlalo ofanayo amaxesha amaninzi apho isiphumo sisondela kumndilili.
y-m-79-06.s.s1.o.d: Ixabiso elilindelekileyo lihlala lilingana nesixa ofumana sona ekuzameni kanye, ngoko ukuba uyabala, lichanekile ngqo nokuba kukuzama kanye.
y-m-79-06.s.s1.r.d: Ixabiso elilindelekileyo yingcamango yomndilili wamazama amaninzi. Asilo ixabiso elifuneka lilingane nesiphumo esinye.
y-m-79-06.s.s1.explain: Isiphumo esinye siyachaphazeleka kakhulu yimpambano. Ukuba lo mdlalo uhambelana nabathathi nxaxheba kwaziwa kuphela ngokuthelekisa intlawulo yokungena nesixa esifunyenwe ngomndilili kumaphepha ayi-100 (ixabiso elilindelekileyo).
y-m-79-06.s.s2.prompt: Misela isixa sekhadi leesipho somvuzo wokuqala P (won) kunye nentlawulo yokungena f (won) ukuze iklasi yanelise zombini iimeko ezilandelayo. Yenza uyilo oluhlukeneyo olu-3. (Imeko 1) Umndilili wentlawulo ngephepha li-f okanye ngaphantsi, ngoko iklasi yethu ayilahlekelwa ngomndilili. (Imeko 2) Imali eyilahlekelwa ngumthathi nxaxheba ngomndilili ngephepha (f − umndilili wentlawulo) i-300 won okanye ngaphantsi. P ikwiiyunithi ze-1000 won ukusuka kwi-5000 won ukuya kwi-30000 won, yaye f ikwiiyunithi ze-100 won ukusuka kwi-100 won ukuya kwi-1000 won.
y-m-79-06.s.s2.hint.0: Qala umisele P enye, ufumane isixa sekhadi leesipho lomvuzo wokuqala namakhadi eesipho ayi-9 omvuzo wesibini, uze wahlule nge-100.
y-m-79-06.s.s2.hint.1: Usebenzisa loo mndilili wentlawulo njengesiseko, fumana iziphelo ezisezantsi nezingaphezulu zoluhlu olunokuthathwa yi-f, uze ukhethe ixabiso kwiiyunithi ze-100 won.

y-m-79-06.s.s2.fail.c1: P kufuneka ibe kwiiyunithi ze-1000 won ukusuka kwi-5000 won ukuya kwi-30000 won.

y-m-79-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Umndilili wentlawulo ngephepha mkhulu kunentlawulo yokungena, ngoko iklasi ilahlekelwa ngomndilili. Thelekisa f nesixa sezixa zamakhadi eesipho omvuzo wokuqala nowesibini sahlulwe ngo-100.
y-m-79-06.s.s2.ok.c4: Umndilili welahleko yomthathi nxaxheba i-300 won okanye ngaphantsi.
y-m-79-06.s.s2.fail.c4: Imali elahlekelwa ngumthathi nxaxheba ngomndilili iphezulu kwi-300 won.
y-m-79-06.s.s2.explain: Umndilili wentlawulo ngephepha yi-(P + 9 × 2000) ÷ 100 = P ÷ 100 + 180 won. Umzekelo, ukuba P = 10000, yi-280 won, ngoko f isuka kwi-280 won ukuya kwi-580 won, yaye kwiiyunithi ze-100 won, i-300, 400, kunye ne-500 won ziyenzeka.
